title: Master Equation River — Coq formalisation of every equation (v1.0: equations 1–79 of Master Equation River v1.4)
description_html:
What this is. A Coq 8.20 development (readout-first, finite/discrete models only: nat, Z, Q, bool, finite lists and records; no Coq.Reals, no classical axioms, no Admitted, no top-level Axiom/Parameter) that formalises every numbered equation of Master Equation River v1.4 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22414412, concept), equations 1–79. Each equation is placed at exactly one tier: Th_coqc where a statement is derivable in a stated finite model (non-collapse laws proved by exhibiting a finite model in which the two readouts differ; accounting identities such as the Citizen Claim Threshold; nesting Πlive ⊆ Πfeas ⊆ Πphys; the discrete-difference form of the audit-index identity; Ẏ>0 ⇏ ṖH>0; Machine expansion ⇏ Human expansion), Definition where the paper defines an object (state spaces, readout maps, vectors, the river as a typed composition), and Open where the paper marks a hypothesis open (stated as a Prop, never proved). verify.sh runs Print Assumptions on every lemma; all report Closed under the global context. MR_Ledger.md maps equation → module → identifier → tier → assumptions, and records where a proved lemma is only a narrow witness of a thesis the paper itself keeps at tier Dr (equations 5, 8, 16). Continuum-looking expressions in the paper (exp, ∂ ln, max over infinite sets) are replaced by declared discrete counterparts and the replacement is recorded in the source comments.

Status. K0 working release of the programme; the formalisation checks internal consistency of the stated discrete models, not empirical truth. Founder ruling BBL-2026-09-06-165 (Blackbox Log). An AI assistant drafted the modules under the author's direction; no AI system is an author or contributor.
